questions.prompt: Graph y = 3 cos(x − π/4) − 2 (x in radians). Place a maximum point and the next minimum point.
questions.answer: Maximum (π/4, 1); next minimum (5π/4, −5); midline y = −2; period 2π.
solutionSteps: Phase shift: π/4 to the right.
Cosine starts at a maximum at x = π/4, so a maximum is at x = π/4 (y = 1).
The next minimum is half a period later, at x = 5π/4 (y = −5).
